meta.purpose: Safari planning reference – not a hotel marketplace. Listings are itinerary-context only.
meta.publishRule: Set verified true only after owner confirms naming, comfort, property type and photo rights.

planning.title: How we choose where you stay
planning.lead: Lodges, camps and guest houses on your route are shaped around season, habitat access and group size – not a generic booking grid.
points: Comfort level (budget, mid-range, luxury) and property type (lodge, tented camp, campsite, villa, bush retreat) are separate choices.
A bush retreat or bush camp night describes the setting and pace – it is not automatically a budget category.
Properties below are named on published itineraries or typical southern bases. Your confirmed proposal may substitute equivalent lodges when availability changes.
We do not publish star ratings, live prices or room inventory on this site – enquire for a written proposal.
